newsitem.title: UK: Hanson shareholders approve first demergers.
newsitem.headline: Hanson shareholders approve first demergers.

text.p: Hanson Plc, the UK conglomerate in the throes of a four-way demerger, said on Wednesday that its shareholders had overwhelmingly approved the flotation plans for Millennium Chemicals and Imperial Tobacco on October 1.
The company said after an extraordinary general meeting: "The demergers are expected to become effective on October 1, assuming certain conditions are met."
A statement fropm the group said dealings in Imperial Tobacco ordinary shares start on the London Stock Exchange at 0730 GMT on October 1.

Trading in Millennium Chemicals kicks off on the New York Stock Exchange on October 2 at 1330 GMT, 0930 EST. Both the timings reflect the respective requirements of each of the exchanges, said Hanson.

Hanson's shares were trading close to the year low of 151 pence before the vote result was announced. Shortly after the result, shares were down 2 and a half pence at 153 and three quarters at 1100 GMT.
